title: Is Complex Query Answering Really Complex?
abstract: arXiv:2410.12537v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Complex query answering (CQA) on knowledge graphs (KGs) is gaining momentum as a challenging reasoning task. In this paper, we show that the current benchmarks for CQA might not be as complex as we think, as the way they are built distorts our perception of progress in this field. For example, we find that in these benchmarks, most queries (up to 98% for some query types) can be reduced to simpler problems, e.g., link prediction, where only one link needs to be predicted. The performance of state-of-the-art CQA models decreases significantly when such models are evaluated on queries that cannot be reduced to easier types. Thus, we propose a set of more challenging benchmarks composed of queries that require models to reason over multiple hops and better reflect the construction of real-world KGs. translated_title: 复杂查询回答真的复杂吗？
translated_abstract: 知识图谱上的复杂查询回答（CQA）作为一种具有挑战性的推理任务正日益受到关注。在本文中，我们展示了当前CQA的基准测试可能并不像我们想象的那么复杂，因为它们的构建方式扭曲了我们对该领域进展的认知。例如，我们发现在这些基准测试中，大多数查询（某些查询类型高达98%）可以简化为更简单的问题，例如链接预测，即只需预测一条链接。当在最先进的CQA模型于无法简化为更简单类型的查询上进行评估时，其性能显著下降。因此，我们提出了一组更具挑战性的基准测试，这些基准测试由需要模型进行多跳推理的查询组成，并更好地反映了现实世界知识图谱的构建方式。在系统的实证研究中，新基准测试表明当前的CQA方法仍有很大改进空间。
tldr: 本文揭示当前知识图谱复杂查询回答基准测试中高达98%的查询可简化为链接预测等简单问题，并提出了需要多跳推理且更贴近真实知识图谱构建的更具挑战性的新基准测试，证明现有方法存在明显不足。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that up to 98% of queries in current knowledge graph complex query answering benchmarks can be reduced to simpler problems like link prediction, and proposes more challenging new benchmarks requiring multi-hop reasoning that better reflect real-world KG construction, demonstrating that existing methods leave much to be desired.
